subject: Development safeguard plan for A. Desai — manager notes & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Development safeguard plan for A. Desai — initial notes

Hi Marcus and Karthik,

Following last week's 1:1 with Aman Desai (Dylan looped in below), I wanted to capture a concise, manager-led plan that keeps us short of a formal PIP but makes expectations and measurement explicit. High level: this is a 6-week focused coaching window with weekly checkpoints, clear success criteria, and HR awareness. Main risk: slippage on delivery quality and defensive behavior in post-mortems.

Proposed structure (for discussion):
- Duration: 6 weeks starting Monday 2027-05-17
- Focus areas: PR review quality (reduce rework), proactive ownership on bugs, cross-team communication (clarity in standups)
- Success criteria (all must be met):
  - <50% rework rate on assigned PRs over the window
  - No high-severity regressions attributable to the assignee
  - Two consecutive positive peer feedback items in weekly check-ins
- Weekly cadence: 30-minute manager check + written note and one actionable item documented in the shared doc

Attachments: initial checkpoint notes (PDF) and a mutual action plan draft.

Please review and call out anything missing — if we agree, Laura, can you confirm HR alignment and any paperwork we should attach to the case?

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Development safeguard plan for A. Desai — initial notes

Neha — thanks for drafting. A couple of clarifications from my side:
1) Can we make the rework metric concrete? I suggest measuring percentage of PRs requiring >1 review iteration for logic bugs versus total PRs in the window.
2) For cross-team comms, add an expectation that Aman posts a short plan in the team Slack channel before EOD on days with riskier merges.

If we lock those in I can run the kickoff with Aman on 5/17 and set the calendar for weekly check-ins.

Also, we should prep examples (redacted) of recent regressions to make feedback concrete — I can provide two.

— Marcus
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: hr-benefits@wellbeing.co
Date: 2027-05-11T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Development safeguard plan for A. Desai — initial notes

Thanks — I reviewed the draft and confirm HR is supportive of a documented development window that stops short of a PIP, provided we: document regular checkpoints, give clear metrics, and record offers of support (coaching, mentor pairing). A few administrative points:
- Please add explicit dates for the start and end of the window in the doc (makes case management easier).
- I recommend adding a short escalation path that mentions when we will move to a formal PIP (e.g., if two consecutive weekly checkpoints show no measurable improvement).
- I'll attach the standard mutual action plan template to the Drive link and can create an HR case record (HR-CASE-2027-1093).

I will not be copied on every weekly note, but please set me and People Ops as watchers on the Drive doc so HR sees progress.

Laura
Laura Bennett
People Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Development safeguard plan for A. Desai — initial notes

Dylan — following up after your 1:1 with Aman on Friday. I want to be transparent: we're setting up a 6-week focused plan starting Monday 5/17. Goal is to give you clear targets and support, not to catch you off-guard. Key asks for you in the kickoff:
- Review the mutual action plan and confirm you understand the success criteria
- Accept pairing sessions with a mentor (Marcus will propose two slots)
- For the first week: document expected risks for any merges and post in #infra-dev by EOD

I attached the checkpoint notes I captured. We'll meet weekly for 30 minutes; please bring concrete examples of where you felt blocked so we can help remove them. If anything in here feels unfair or unclear, raise it in the first check-in or with Laura.

Best,
Neha
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Development safeguard plan for A. Desai — initial notes

Thanks Neha — I appreciate the transparency and the concrete steps. Quick notes after reading the doc and talking with Marcus:
- I accept the 6-week window and will start the daily risk posts on merges next week.
- Two asks from my side: 1) a short written example of the rework metric so I know how PRs will be counted; 2) one dedicated deep-dive pairing session in week 2 focused on test strategy for the module I own.

If you can add the metric example to the shared drive by EOD Monday I can sign off and we can kick off on 5/17.

— Dylan
